reasoning:
**What is asked.** The highest intraday VIX value (the Cboe daily HIGH) between Monday 23 November and Friday 4 December 2026: nine sessions, with Thanksgiving closed and a half day on 27 November.

**Starting point.** The VIX closed at 25.45 on Tuesday 17 November 2026, its fourth rise in a row, after touching about 27.7 during the session as the S&P 500 dipped under 7,300 (VX Dawn Run newsletter and TokenPost, both 17 November). This month it has swung from 16.61 on 4 November to a high of 28.4 on 5 November and back to 18.70 on 12 November (stockwirex, Apex Vol).

**Before the window opens.** Three sessions remain. Nvidia's results late on 17 November beat forecasts and the shares rose about 4% after hours. S&P futures were up 0.7% and the front VIX future traded near 21.7 that evening, so the market expects spot to fall back quickly. FOMC minutes on 18 November and Anthropic's expected listing come first. I assume the VIX enters the window around 21.5, give or take 3.

**Inside the window.** The peak cannot end far below the opening level and usually ends about 10% above it. Thanksgiving week is normally quiet. The second week has ISM surveys and the November jobs report, due on 4 December, and a Fed meeting priced for a rate hike follows on 8-9 December. Volatility of volatility is high: the VIX has topped 27 twice in nine sessions, the 10-year yield is above 5% and Nvidia has no permanent chief.

**Forecast.** Median 24.2; middle half 21.8 to 27.8; 5th to 95th percentile 18.9 to 36.5. A peak under 20 needs a fast and lasting calm like that of 12-13 November. One above 35 needs a shock larger than 5 November.
question_title: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)
